description: Changes a template's title and/or its gallery image and icon. Images come from the media library: upload with media_upload_link, pass the reported "mediaId" (stored by URL - deleting the file breaks the image). Only what you pass changes; the template's content cannot be changed (create a new template from the edited Riddle). Public templates only by Riddle admins. Returns the template like riddle_template_create. Without full access only for a Riddle whose origin.writableByThisKey is true: riddle://reference/concepts/access.

coverMediaId.description: Media library image (the "mediaId" media_upload_link reports) to show as the template's "image". Omit to keep the current one.

remove.description: Images to take away again: the cover then falls back to the Riddle's cover, the icon to the type's default.

title.description: New title. Omit to keep it.

name: riddle_template_update
